mapper.select:
SELECT MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER.TRADER_ID id, MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER.TRADER_NAME text, MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER.MPARTY_ID parentId FROM MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER
AND (MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER.TRADER_ID like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')) or MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER.TRADER_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')))
AND (MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER.TRADER_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER.TRADER_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
AND (MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER.MPARTY_ID = #{counterId} OR MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER.MPARTY_ID = ( SELECT MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_RELA.MPARTY_ID FROM MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_RELA WHERE MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_RELA.SPARTY_ID = #{counterId}))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_USER_ADD WHERE MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER.TRADER_ID = SYS_USER_ADD.IBU_TRADER) AND (MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER.MPARTY_ID = #{mySide} OR MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER.MPARTY_ID = ( SELECT MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_RELA.MPARTY_ID FROM MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_RELA WHERE MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_RELA.SPARTY_ID = #{mySide}))
AND MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER.TRADER_ID = #{initValue}

SELECT DISTINCT MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ID id, MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ABBR text
,( select sua.IBU_TRADER from SYS_USER su left join SYS_USER_ADD sua on sua.USER_ID = su.USER_ID where su.USER_NAME = #{userName} ) object
FROM MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO
AND (MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ID like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')) or MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')))
AND (MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
AND MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ID = #{initValue}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IBU_PORTFOLIO_ACCT_RELA WHERE IBU_PORTFOLIO_ACCT_RELA.PARTY_ID = MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ID AND IBU_PORTFOLIO_ACCT_RELA.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId})
AND MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ABBR = #{counterName}

SELECT DISTINCT MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ID id, MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ABBR text FROM MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO
AND (MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ID like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')) or MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')))
AND (MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
AND MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ID = #{initValue}
SELECT FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId} AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2}

SELECT T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, T1.FINPROD_ABBR text, T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T1.FINPROD_NAME, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.CALENDAR_ID, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.IS_RIGHT, T2.TYPE_4, T1.VDATE, T1.MDATE, T1.CCY, T1.REGIST_ORG FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID
T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{assestType} AND T1.TRADE_MARKET = '01'
and (T1.FINPROD_ID = #{initValue} OR T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{initValue})
and (T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or T1.FINPROD_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{assestType}
SELECT CFETS_ACCT_TYPE FROM IBU_PORTFOLIO_ACCT_RELA WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} and PARTY_ID = #{partyId} and rownum = 1

SELECT V.SEC_ACCT_ID AS SECACCTID FROM PTL_SEC_ACCT PSA, STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO V LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT R ON R.REGIST_ORG = V.REGIST_ORG WHERE PSA.ACCT_NO = V.SEC_ACCT_ID AND V.SEC_ACCT_TYPE = 'SEC' AND V.TRADE_PLACE = '01' AND PSA.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND R.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
SELECT P.ACCT_NO CASHACCTID FROM PTL_CAPACCT_INFO P LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO S ON P.ACCT_NO = S.ACCT_NO where P.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND P.ACCT_TYPE = #{acctType} and rownum=1

select distinct ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID code, ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID name from ETR_ENTRUST
ETR_ENTRUST.TRADE_MARKET = '01'
AND ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%'))
AND ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID like concat('%',concat(#{type},'%'))
select mcp.COUNTER_ID from MST_COUNTER_PARTY mcp INNER JOIN MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO mcci ON mcp.PARTY_ID = mcci.PARTY_ID WHERE mcci.PARTY_ID = #{cpPartyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select count(*) from ( select ENTRUST_ID from WFL_IBU_QUOTE_BOND2 where ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId} union all select ENTRUST_ID from WFL_IBU_QUOTE_CREP where ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId} union all select ENTRUST_ID from IBU_QUOTE_BOND where ENTRUST_ID= #{entrustId} and TRADE_STATUS not in ('06','08') union all select ENTRUST_ID from IBU_QUOTE_CREP where ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId} and TRADE_STATUS not in ('06','08') )

SELECT A.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, A.TRADER trader, A.TRADING_HEADER tradingHeader, A.CREATE_USER createUser, A.CREATE_DEPT createDept, A.CREATE_TIME createTime, A.UPDATE_USER updateUser, A.UPDATE_TIME updateTime
FROM ETR_DISTRIBUTE_INTERF_TMP A
1=1
AND A.Entrust_Id = #{entrustId}

SELECT
FROM ETR_QUOTE_FINISH_STATUS
1=1
AND entrust_Id = #{entrustId}

select iqb.QUOTE_ID, iqb.QUOTE_TYPE from IBU_QUOTE_BOND iqb inner join IBU_QUOTE_BOND_DET iqbd on iqb.QUOTE_ID = iqbd.QUOTE_ID where iqbd.EXECID = #{execId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and iqb.TRADE_STATUS != '15'
union all
select iqc.QUOTE_ID, '03' as QUOTE_TYPE from IBU_QUOTE_CREP iqc where iqc.EXECID = #{execId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and iqc.TRADE_STATUS != '15'
SELECT P.ACCT_NO FROM PTL_CAPACCT_INFO P LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO S ON P.ACCT_NO = S.ACCT_NO where P.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND P.ACCT_TYPE = #{acctType} and rownum=1
